newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean gov't mulls raising local LNG, LPG prices.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean gov't mulls raising local LNG, LPG prices.

text.p: South Korea's Ministry of Finance and Economy is considering increasing domestic prices of liquefied natural gas (LNG) and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), ministry officials said on Thursday.
"We are considering raising local LNG and LPG prices due to high import prices," said an official in charge of gas prices at the ministry.
The retail price of LNG averages 245 won per cubic metre and 510 won per kilogram for LPG.
Prices for the fuels were last raised in August 1995.
